output.brief: Regulars are leaving because of a gap, not because of the app alone or the background checks. RotaWeave's basic tier has no recurring bookings, so regulars keep their usual slot only if staff book them in before the Thursday release. Before 1 May, coordinators did this (about 74 bookings a week at Dock Street and Westgate). Since the posts were cut, it's about 3 a week, and one admin seat sits unused. At Dock Street and Westgate, 129 of 213 April regulars lost their usual slot at least twice, and 88% of them are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept it. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and it is stable. Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app, and it is also stable. So the app and the cut together do the damage. Background checks don't explain it: 121 of the 123 who lapsed were current on their check. Commonplate shows little sign of poaching: only 2 of 61 callbacks joined another group. Don't cancel RotaWeave, don't suspend the checks, and don't purge the roster. Assign the unused admin seat to book regulars into their usual slots, and phone lapsed regulars to offer their slot back. Review after 60 days. Also plan this before Quarry Lane goes live on 6 Oct. I'm fairly confident, though the data is observational.
